text:
sophie: Heads up — prepping private installer bundle 1.5.0 for VPC/on‑prem customers. Targeting tomorrow change window 2026-06-14 06:00-10:00 UTC. This is a packaging + handoff thread for cosign signing, checksums, and canary rollout plan.

deploy-bot: artifact created: release-1.5.0-private-20260614; staging: s3://redwood-artifacts/private/release-1.5.0/; manifest pinned to sha256:3a1f9b...c7b (short).

raj: Quick question — is base runtime image pinned to gcr.redwood-inference/private-runtime@sha256:6d4f9e...? We want no implicit rollforward during canary.

ben: +1 on pinning. Also calling out rollback criteria: if canary error rate > 5% for 10m or any failing healthcheck across both canaries -> rollback to release-1.4.9. Who owns the onprem pull-runner rollback hook?

sylvia: I'll run the canaries (EU + US) at 5% each. Request to enable ENABLE_VERBOSE=1 for canary runs to capture startup traces.

ops-bot: packaging checklist: [x] checksums generated (checksums.txt), [x] cosign signatures uploaded, [x] cosign pubkey in keyring, [x] offline manifest included, [ ] docs updated. Verify commands below.

ops-bot: ```
# verify image signature
cosign verify --key cosign.pub gcr.redwood-inference/private-runtime@sha256:6d4f9e...
# verify tarball checksums
sha256sum -c checksums.txt
# example delta apply (airgap)
tar -C /opt/redwood -xzf delta-1.5.0.tgz
```

sophie: Copying in the minimal rollback playbook for onprem: 1) remove canary manifest from customer artifact bucket 2) revoke tag alias (update tag -> previous digest) 3) push rollback-notice to customers and open support ticket 4) if signature rotation required, coordinate with secops to re-sign. Keep it fast and scriptable.

raj: Also add a release-note bullet: "kv-cache layout migration — upgrade-time small warmup required, no data loss expected." Put that in the PR so support has it.

ben: Confirming rollback steps. One ask: keep a pinned copy of v1.4.9 in staging for immediate repush.

deploy-bot: change window scheduled: 2026-06-14T06:00:00Z - 2026-06-14T10:00:00Z; canary rollout triggered at 2026-06-14T06:15:00Z. Notifying: @oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Pager duty: @oncall-sre. I will watch alerts for the window.

sophie: Note for onprem installers shipped in the airgap tarball — include the offline CA bundle and manifest.json at top level. This avoids manual manifest assembly at customer site.

sylvia: Canary started. First boot logs look good, no immediate errors in bootstrap. :thumbsup:

ben: If anything goes sideways, call the rollback and tag me.

sophie: Thanks team — I'll mark docs done once PR merges. Final artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/private/release-1.5.0/{images,airgap,checksums.txt,manifest.json,cosign.sig}.
